title: GameWs
description: Messages on the game WebSocket (/ws?sessionId=…) between the browser and the backend. Server → client: Snapshot, NoticeMessage, ErrorMessage, CameraMessage. Client → server: ClientMessage. The server closes the socket with a WsCloseCode.

WsCloseCode.title: WsCloseCode
WsCloseCode.description: Close codes the backend sends. The client stops reconnecting on Unauthorized (go to login), Forbidden and NotFound.

NoticeMessage.title: NoticeMessage
NoticeMessage.description: A transient hint for this viewer, e.g. a dart thrown on a board that isn't up.

throwerBoard.description: Name of the board they throw on; null when they enter darts by hand.

ErrorMessage.title: ErrorMessage
ErrorMessage.description: An action of this viewer was refused.

CameraMessage.title: CameraMessage
CameraMessage.description: A board in this game has a new camera still: fetch it from GET /api/boards/{boardId}/camera/{cam}?v={version}. Also sent for every stored still right after the first snapshot.

cam.description: Camera number, 0-based; 3 is the combined still.

version.description: Goes up with every still of this board and camera.
